2. **Rolled back** all production regions to v2.3.0.
3. **Verified** — checkout-api is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions, with error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** for checkout-api titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0", with a summary describing the failure, the rollback action, and the note that v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production (so any future redeploy of it will require change-manager approval).
